instruction_summary: Produce a calibrated, updated theory for ADH (2013) that reconciles the original strong contemporaneous China-shock effect with 001's finding that the effect fades when the import flow stops yet high-exposure places stay scarred; recalibrate the model's central parameter, make the smallest amendment, and validate it.

steps.description: Read replication + 001 artifacts (paper theory Eqs.2-3, iv.py, table3.csv, 001 exposure/levels/estimates CSVs)
Rebuilt venv from replication package list
steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install pandas numpy scipy linearmodels statsmodels matplotlib openpyxl xlrd pyarrow

steps.description: Recalibrated single ADH incidence elasticity by era; estimated the updated directional-hysteresis (ratchet) model; ran the level/permanent-downshift test; ran the held-out 2019-24 out-of-sample validation; built calibration table and trajectories
Built the 4-panel model-comparison figure (original vs updated) plus a compact card figure
Wrote the theory section, report, and cards

key_results.updated_model: dynamic incidence with directional hysteresis (ratchet): d_mfgshare = -b+ * max(dIPW,0) - b- * min(dIPW,0); ADH = the reversible b+=b- special case; one added parameter = recovery rate rho
key_results.recovery_rate_rho: -0.17 (95% CI excludes 1.0; pre-2019 rho=-0.34); ADH assumes 1.00 -> reversibility rejected

comparison_to_original.quantity: Impact incidence elasticity b+ (mfg pp per +$1k/wkr, rising imports)
comparison_to_original.note: Same sign and order of magnitude; the impact leg of the model survives recalibration.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Recovery rate rho = b-/b+ (fraction of the level hit that reverses)
comparison_to_original.original: 1.00 (implied by ADH's reversible static flow model, Eqs. 2-3)
comparison_to_original.source_file: paper.pdf Section I / Theory Appendix (theory); this study theory_metrics.json (estimate)
comparison_to_original.note: New structural parameter. Reversibility is rejected: high-exposure CZs did not recover when imports receded.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Single-slope ADH elasticity in the 2019-24 reversal era
comparison_to_original.note: A constant alpha is misspecified; it drifts to ~0 then wrong sign as the flow reverses -> motivates the ratchet.

comparison_to_original.quantity: Net / permanent level effect of accumulated exposure
comparison_to_original.original: 0 (transitory: flow model predicts full recovery once the flow stops)
comparison_to_original.note: The China-shock employment hit is permanent through 2023, not transitory.

deviations: The recovery leg of the directional FLOW ratchet is weakly instrumented (pooled 2SLS partial first-stage F=2.2) because China's exports to the 8 instrument countries did not fall with the US-specific post-2018 reversal; the recovery rate rho is therefore CALIBRATED from the well-identified LEVEL test (dose instrument F approx 30), and OLS on the flow split (rho approx 0.47, attenuated) is reported for context. All approaches agree rho<1 and that the level effect is permanent.

Manufacturing-share outcome is 001's CBP-jobs-per-working-age-resident proxy, not ADH's Census/ACS person-level measure (IPUMS unavailable); 001 validated the proxy (W2 proxy approx ADH original). Levels differ; cross-window/cross-CZ comparisons are the consistent objects.

The updated model is CALIBRATED to moments 001 already produced, not fully structurally estimated (a clean instrument for the reversal is unavailable in-session), as the instruction permits; forward-looking implications are labeled [PROPOSED].
No data re-fetched or re-built: all inputs reused from followup/001-living-update; the ADH canonical coefficient read from replication/outputs/table3.csv.
